title: Three Women Go to Jail Over a $1 Pizza
description:
A disagreement over a one-dollar pizza price at a Kewanee, Illinois gas station erupted into chaos when police were called to handle what officers initially described as a civil matter. According to police, 18-year-old Diamond Lockhart, 27-year-old Keanna Simpson, and 33-year-old Nikita Simpson refused to leave the store after being trespassed, leading to multiple confrontations with officers. Authorities say officers were pushed, struck, and had equipment damaged during the altercation, while Nikita Simpson allegedly threw store merchandise to the ground. All three women were arrested and booked on charges including aggravated battery to a police officer, resisting arrest, and criminal damage to property. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
